articles.title_en: ‘It feels like the light is pushing the darkness apart’: Gellért Gombai’s best phone
articles.title_ru: ‘It feels like the light is pushing the darkness apart’: Gellért Gombai’s best phone
articles.preview_en: The photographer was holidaying with his family when two shadows became a plaything for his young son Gellért Gombai, his wife and two children spend much of the year at their home in Budapest, Hungar
articles.preview_ru: The photographer was holidaying with his family when two shadows became a plaything for his young son Gellért Gombai, his wife and two children spend much of the year at their home in Budapest, Hungar
articles.full_en: The photographer was holidaying with his family when two shadows became a plaything for his young son Gellért Gombai, his wife and two children spend much of the year at their home in Budapest, Hungary, but most of their summers in Alsóörs. “It’s a small holiday village on Lake Balaton, the largest in central Europe, so it’s often referred to as the Hungarian sea,” Gombai, a freelance photographer, says. “We go to the playground and beach most days, swim, and eat beach food, but even when I’m enjoying my holiday, I’m looking out for interesting moments to capture.” On this particular day, the family had eaten hotdogs for lunch, before Gombai had taken the kids, Lóci and Janka, to the playground. “Lóci, who was five at the time, was jumping between two shadows – one from a changing room, and the other from a building’s roof,” he says. “I asked him to stay still for a few minutes while I got the shot, and he lay like this on the ground. He’s a big-hearted little clown; I’m so glad he’s my son.” When he showed the children, “Janka immediately asked me to take the same shot of her, which often happens. Lóci said it looked like he was among mountains, or as though a monster was about to eat him.” Continue reading...

articles.title_en: Replit Ends Partnership With Anthropic, CEO Announces Change.
articles.title_ru: Реплит прекращает сотрудничество с Энтропик, сообщает генеральный директор.
articles.preview_en: Replit’s CEO announced that the company is ending its partnership with Anthropic and will switch to OpenAI’s models.
articles.preview_ru: Генеральный директор Реплит заявил, что компания прекращает сотрудничество с Энтропик и переходит к моделям ОпенЭй.
articles.full_en: Replit’s chief executive announced on Monday that the firm is ending its collaboration with Anthropic. Replit clarified that OpenAI will replace Anthropic as the default model provider on its platform. The decision follows a strategic review of AI partnerships conducted over the past quarter. The shift is significant because OpenAI’s models are widely adopted and offer broader capabilities. Industry analysts note that the move could accelerate competition among cloud AI services. Developers using Replit will still have access to Claude, Anthropic’s model, for legacy projects. The announcement underscores Replit’s commitment to delivering cutting‑edge AI tools to its users.
articles.full_ru: Генеральный директор Реплит объявил в понедельник, что компания прекращает сотрудничество с Энтропик. Реплит уточнил, что модели ОпенЭй заменят Энтропик в качестве провайдера моделей по умолчанию на платформе. Это решение последовало после стратегического обзора партнёрств в области ИИ, проведённого за последний квартал. Перемена важна, поскольку модели ОпенЭй широко распространены и предоставляют более широкие возможности. Эксперты отрасли отмечают, что такой шаг может ускорить конкуренцию среди облачных сервисов ИИ. Разработчики, использующие Реплит, сохранят доступ к Клод от Энтропик для существующих проектов. Объявление подчёркивает приверженность Реплит предоставлять пользователям передовые инструменты ИИ.
articles.meta_en: Replit ends its partnership with Anthropic and adopts OpenAI models, impacting developers on its platform.
